gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent High-grade Glioma; Grade III Astrocytoma; Oligodendroglioma; Oligoastrocytoma; Ependymoma; Grade IV Astrocytoma

Patients must have a histologically confirmed diagnosis of a non-brainstem high-grade glioma (NB-HGG, WHO Grade III or IV astrocytoma, oligodendrogliomas, oligoastrocytomas, ependymomas) that is recurrent, progressive or refractory following radiotherapy with or without chemotherapy.

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma named only as historical 'Grade IV Astrocytoma' (D27C) in a paediatric/young-adult HGG trial (ages 4-26); could be read as high_grade_glioma_unspecified.

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a Phase I study of ex vivo expanded CD34+ hematopoietic stem cells (exHSCs) plus nivolumab in pediatric patients with histologically confirmed diagnosis of a non-brainstem high-grade glioma

coder_notes: Paediatric-focused HGG trial (ages 4-26, stdAges CHILD and ADULT). Nivolumab is the only pharmacological investigational agent (exHSC is a cell therapy, excluded type), so nivolumab experimental_monotherapy while regimen is combination with exHSC. Two non-randomised arms differ only in timing relative to surgery (adjuvant vs neoadjuvant); neither is a control.
